answer: One defense is a verifiable delay function (VDF) gate at registration: before joining the economy, each agent must compute a sequential puzzle taking ten minutes of wall-clock time that no extra machines can speed up, like a gale every sailor must weather alone no matter how many boats they own. An atlas of issued identities records each completed VDF, so duplicates are visible. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must wander through a thousand sequential delays, turning Sybil creation from a cheap parallel script into months of waiting, while honest agents pay the delay only once.
